sources.title: Online Visa Application: current named sponsor alerts
sources.officialityEvidence: The current eta.gov.lk portal is the Department's official electronic travel-authorisation service and publishes the named nationality alerts.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitors from Taiwan-China and Kosovo ... may apply through Sri Lankan Sponsor at the Head office.

sources.title: Special Notice to Short-Term Visitors
sources.officialityEvidence: The Department of Immigration and Emigration publishes this current ETA notice on its official immigration.gov.lk domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: nationals of all other countries shall continue to be subject to the general rules and regulations governing the Sri Lanka ETA system.

unresolved.reason: The current ETA portal names Taiwan-China for a sponsor-led head-office Tourist or Business visa application with sponsor, police-clearance, passport and accommodation documents. Its separate current Department notice broadly retains the ETA system for all other countries; it does not state whether the named route displaces ETA. No single ordinary-passport status is established.
